```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

Import our first dataset

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data_import_examples/FAS_litters.csv",
     na = c("NA", "", ".")    
    )
litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df) # converts var names to snake case
```

Import second dataset

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv(file = "data_import_examples/FAS_pups.csv"
           ,skip = 3,  # skips first two lines
           na = c("NA", " ", ".")
           )
pups_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)
tail(pups_df,5)
```
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```

```{r}
view(pups_df) # lets you see the full data set
```
